cgu.title: Terms of use
cgu.s1: These terms of use govern access to and use of the EasyPhysio platform by physiotherapists and their patients.
cgu.s2: EasyPhysio provides physiotherapists with a tool for following their patients' exercises remotely. EasyPhysio is not a medical device and does not provide care: the exercise programme is drawn up and approved by the physiotherapist, who remains solely responsible for the clinical follow-up of their patient.
cgu.s3Intro: The app is free for the physiotherapist. The patient subscribes to two separate services, sold by two separate sellers, which are paid for and invoiced separately:
cgu.s3Platform: access to the EasyPhysio platform (€{low} to €{high} per month depending on the plan, VAT not applicable), sold by EasyPhysio: app, videos, messaging and secure hosting of health data;
cgu.s3Kine: their physiotherapist's programme (€{kine} per month), sold by the physiotherapist: updating their exercise programme « hors nomenclature » (outside the French national fee schedule).
cgu.s3Total: That is €{low} to €{high} per month depending on the plan chosen, the physiotherapist's €{kine} being due only in months when they update the programme. Access: {offers}. The commitment only covers access to the platform; at the end of it, access continues at the same price, month by month, and can be cancelled at any time. EasyPhysio receives no share of the physiotherapist's fees, and the physiotherapist receives no share of the platform access.
cgu.s4a: On the first subscription, the first {trial} days are free: nothing is charged during this period, and the date of the first payment is shown before the card is saved. The patient accepts both amounts in writing before subscribing. They save their card only once: it is used by EasyPhysio for access and by the physiotherapist for their fees.
cgu.s4b: Platform access is charged every month by EasyPhysio while the subscription is active. The physiotherapist collects their fees directly into their own account, only in months when they update the patient's programme, after that update has been made and never during the trial; they issue a fee note in their own name. This follow-up is not reimbursed by the French national health insurance (Assurance Maladie). Payments are processed by Stripe.
cgu.s4c: The patient can cancel at any time from their space: they keep access until the end of the current month, after which no further payment is taken, either by EasyPhysio or by their physiotherapist. If a payment is declined, access is suspended until a valid card is saved. Care at the practice does not depend on this follow-up, and the patient always keeps the right to export or delete their data.
cgu.s5: The patient can delete their account at any time from their personal space; their current subscription is then cancelled. The physiotherapist can also delete their own account at any time, free of charge.
cgu.s6: These terms are governed by French law.
cgu.s7: If you have any questions, contact us from your account.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — EasyPhysio
privacy.s1: EasyPhysio is a tool provided to physiotherapists (masseurs-kinésithérapeutes) for following their patients' exercises. The physiotherapist remains the healthcare professional responsible for clinical follow-up; EasyPhysio is the publisher of the software tool.
privacy.s2a: Account and identification (name, email, encrypted password); health data (condition, recovery stage, physical profile, how you feel and pain, sessions completed, messages with your physiotherapist); billing data, handled by our payment provider — we never store any card number.
privacy.s2b: Waiting list. If you leave your email address on the home page to be told about the launch, we keep only that address and your status (physio or patient). It is used only to announce the launch to you, is shared with no one, and is deleted on simple request or at the latest one year after the launch.
privacy.s3: Your health data is processed on the basis of your explicit consent (article 9 of the GDPR — RGPD in French), collected when you sign up. Account and billing data is processed for the performance of the contract between us.
privacy.s4Title: 4. Who has access to your data
privacy.s4: The physiotherapist who follows you — never another physiotherapist or another patient. This separation is enforced technically at database level, not just in what is displayed. EasyPhysio neither sells nor rents any data.
privacy.s5: Article L.1111-8 of the French Public Health Code (Code de la santé publique) requires personal health data to be hosted by a provider certified as a Health Data Host (Hébergeur de Données de Santé, HDS). EasyPhysio is currently migrating to such certified hosting; this section will be updated as soon as the migration is complete, with the name of the certified provider. Passwords are encrypted, never stored in plain text.
privacy.s6: EasyPhysio relies on the following providers to operate, each accessing only the data strictly needed for its role: Clerk (authentication and account management), Stripe (payment processing — EasyPhysio neither sees nor stores any card number), and our database host (storage of health and follow-up data). None of these providers is allowed to use your data for any purpose other than providing their service to EasyPhysio.
privacy.s7: To improve the site, we anonymously measure visits to the public pages and the physio space (page views, clicks) with PostHog, hosted in the European Union. No cookie is set and nothing is stored on your device; displayed text, names, email addresses and identifiers are not sent. The patient space is never measured: no health data is sent to PostHog. If your browser asks not to be tracked (“Do Not Track”), no measurement is made.
privacy.s8: Your data is kept for as long as your follow-up lasts. If you delete your account, it is deleted or anonymised, unless a legal obligation requires it to be kept longer.
privacy.s9: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your data, to object, and to withdraw your consent at any time. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).
privacy.s10: EasyPhysio does not currently use any generative artificial intelligence that processes your personal health data.
privacy.s11: If you have any questions about this policy or your data, contact us from your account.
